notes: Checked 2026-10-26 on a Fajer Show embed (streamtape.com/e/ID; AsiaTVDrama's Streamtape servers are on older titles, and the two found today were deleted). The embed page hides the video address in elements (#botlink, #robotlink…) whose HTML holds decoy tokens; a script then writes the real one into them, as two strings joined after cutting a few letters off the second (“'//streamta' + ('xyzape.com/get_video?…').substring(4)”). The letters cut are only the host's, so Sahra reads the get_video?… part of the first such script line, adds &stream=1 as the page's player does, and opens it on the embed's own host; it redirects to the mp4 on tapecontent.net. HTML (a script string), no API, nothing executed.
